findings.title: No node matches the pod's node selector
findings.cause: the pod's nodeSelector pins it to node kd-faults-worker-old by kubernetes.io/hostname, and there is no node kd-faults-worker-old (the nodes are kd-faults-control-plane): a node that was replaced or renamed keeps no pods pinned to it; Deployment web has 0 of 1 replicas ready

evidence.detail: 0/1 nodes are available: 1 node(s) didn't match Pod's node affinity/selector. preemption: 0/1 nodes are available: 1 Preemption is not helpful for scheduling.

evidence.command: kubectl get pod web-9755df678-q7hzj -n kd-nodeselector-node-gone -o jsonpath='{.spec.nodeSelector}'

findings.fix: Label a node to match (kubectl label node), or correct the pod's nodeSelector or affinity.
